probes.title: Forward traversal to repeated view chooses the earlier occurrence
probes.limitations: Exact popstate callback with synthetic browser target; does not render the browser back button. URL view is correct but internal traversal index is not.

probes.title: Clicking an already read notification subtracts another unread item
probes.limitations: Exact mutation callback; NotificationItem invokes it even for a read row. Simulated successful update, no database write.

probes.title: Realtime update before mutation completion causes a second unread decrement
probes.limitations: Exact event and mutation callbacks with synthetic event order. Variant of the counter reconciliation defect; no actual Supabase subscription.

probes.title: Three notification toggles change cache without issuing a database write
probes.limitations: Exact whole settings hook with React Query/Auth/DB stubs. The current NotificationTypeSection exposes all three controls.

probes.title: Reset leaves defaults in cache and resolves despite returned database error
probes.limitations: Exact reset hook. Static consumer announces reset before awaiting this promise; no real preference changed.

probes.title: Email image hook preserves protocol-relative remote URL while blocking its absolute equivalent
probes.limitations: Executes exact privacy hook with an Element substitute, not DOMPurify or a DOM/network stack. Official DOMPurify docs permit protocol-relative URLs by default; actual browser request and deployment CSP were not measured.

probes.title: A new hook instance reads the previous instance search history from a global key
probes.limitations: Exact whole hook with synthetic React/localStorage. No actual login/logout or browser profile was exercised. Static Auth logout paths clear other caches but neither this key nor all localStorage; finding requires two sessions in the same browser origin/profile.

probes.title: Undo action from the older toast reverts the newer operation
probes.limitations: Exact execute callback and its emitted toast closure with synthetic non-firing timers and no-op forward actions. Current bulkArchive consumer permits another operation after its mutation resolves; no Sonner UI, database or real archive executed.

probes.title: Independent shortcut instances overwrite the prior row customization
probes.limitations: Exact saveShortcuts/updateShortcut callbacks, synthetic two-entry registry and localStorage. Current settings uses one hook per row plus a parent hook; global listener has another. This proves isolated state/write behavior, not a mounted React or keyboard interaction test.

method: Exact AST callbacks or whole modules, all HEAD/blob checks before evaluation. Explicit synthetic state/DB/Element boundaries; no browser rendering.
